deepfake_detection_with_reasoning:
Listen to this audio clip: <Speech><SpeechHere></Speech>. You are an expert audio forensics analyst specializing in detecting synthetic speech. Assess whether the audio sample contains genuine human speech or synthesized artificial speech.

Structure your response as follows:

1. Start with exactly one <answer></answer> tag: a single word verdict, Real or Fake.

2. Then, inside <observations></observations>, list each distinct acoustic cue supporting that verdict as a numbered list, one cue per line, in this exact format:
<observations>
1. First observation.
2. Second observation.
</observations>
If the audio is real, 1-2 observations are usually enough.

3. Add one or two <reasoning_step></reasoning_step> tags linking the Observations to the verdict. Each reasoning_step must be a single short sentence stating the cue-to-verdict link directly.

4. Add exactly one <conclusion></conclusion> tag: a single short sentence restating the verdict.

Output only:
<answer>Real/Fake</answer>
<reasoning><observations>...</observations><reasoning_step>...</reasoning_step>...<conclusion>...</conclusion></reasoning>
